entry.summary: Since 23 April 2026, non-visa nationals arriving from outside the Common Travel Area need a UK ETA, which the UK runs for Jersey, Guernsey and the Isle of Man. Arriving from the UK, the UK ETA already covers it.
entry.max_stay: Up to 6 months as a visitor
entry.pre_arrival: Apply at gov.uk/eta/apply or the UK ETA app at least three working days before travel; £20 (about A$38 at RBA, 30 October 2026: A$1 = £0.5258).

seasons-and-flow.climate: Wettest: October, November and December. Driest: May, June and July. Hottest: August (18.5°C average). Coolest: February (6.6°C average). Country-wide averages for 1991 to 2020; coasts, mountains and the far north or south can differ a lot.

culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: No FCDO advice page exists for Jersey, and no official etiquette guidance has been checked yet. Ask locally. Visit Jersey: plan around tides and follow coastal access signs. High-street shops are normally closed on Sundays.
culture-and-protocol.note: No official source read; the authority is named so it can be asked.
